summary: The complete single-file notebook viewer as one exported string (VIEW_TEMPLATE), with __TITLE__ and __DATA_JSON__ substituted by renderViewHtml. It IS the source: unlike the graph viewer there is no generator for it - scripts/kb-viewer/ holds only build-site-page.mjs, which BAKES this template for the marketing site - so edit it here. Its file header used to claim the opposite ('generated from the design source; do not hand-edit') and was corrected. The :root token block is the shared brand surface for both the local `kb view` output and /notebook/ on the site, so theming it here is what keeps the two identical. Three decisions are load-bearing and are documented in the header: it stays LIGHT-grounded because it is a long-form reading surface for note prose; --file is frost and --flow is ember (a file note is a fixed address, a flow note is a path through the code), and the canvas graph reads separate brighter --file-node/--flow-node so text can keep the dark on-white values; the freshness scale stays a green/amber/red traffic light because that is status rather than brand, with --changed pushed redder specifically so it does not collide with the new ember --flow. Fonts stay system stacks on purpose - the output is opened as a local file, often offline, so a webfont here would look correct in the repo and fail for the user.
